messages: Executable PHP-like filenames found in media

findings.message: Executable PHP-like filenames found in media

evidence.scope: pub/media filenames; server execution policy requires separate evidence

findings.confidence_basis: Confidence describes the observed condition or relationship only; exploitation, runtime reachability and business impact are not established by this label.

guidance.impact: The reported pattern or supported output/declaration relationship warrants review. Credential validity, executable serving, alternate authorization and actual input influence require evidence specific to this location.
guidance.action: Investigate and change: Inspect the reported PHP-like media filenames privately without executing them. Quarantine unauthorized content and review upload validation and server execution denial; distinguish legitimate reviewed artifacts from compromise indicators.

messages: Configured executable-content signatures found in upload inventory

findings.message: Configured executable-content signatures found in upload inventory

evidence.scope: configured upload paths; PHP-like filenames, explicit PHP tags and htaccess script-handler signatures

findings.confidence_basis: Confidence describes the observed condition or relationship only; exploitation, runtime reachability and business impact are not established by this label.

guidance.impact: The reported pattern or supported output/declaration relationship warrants review. Credential validity, executable serving, alternate authorization and actual input influence require evidence specific to this location.
guidance.action: Quarantine the reported upload object outside the served tree for investigation; do not execute it. Determine how the PHP tag, PHP-like filename or script-handler override entered the upload path. Fix the real upload pipeline using server-derived type/extension policy, generated names, size limits and authorization; configure the delivery server so media cannot execute scripts.
guidance.verification: Test harmless accepted and rejected upload fixtures in isolation, verify no unintended handler overrides, and rerun the complete configured upload inventory. Resolve symlinks, unreadable or oversized eligible files before interpreting a clean result.
guidance.recheck: Rerun MB-0800 against the same release, profile and relevant file/key/package scope; compare the new evidence and inspect any independent collection gaps.
